children: is scheduled to announce Q3 earnings results on Wednesday, November 4th, before market open.
and the consensus revenue estimate is $DKK 73.79B (vs DKK 74.98B in Q3 2025).
For Q2, Novo Nordisk reported net sales of DKK 78.49B, driven by GLP-1 volume growth across geographies and favorable U.S. rebate adjustments.
The Danish drugmaker raised its full-year outlook for the second time this year in August, citing increased expectations for GLP-1 product sales.
It expects sales and operating profit to decline by no more than 6% at constant exchange rates this year, improving from its previous forecast of declines of up to 12%.
Investor sentiment will be largely positive going into the Q3 readout, with key rival Eli Lilly
also reporting better-than-expected results and raising its full-year revenue outlook last week, on the strength of the GLP-1 market.
All eyes will be on the performance of Novo Nordisk’s oral Wegovy pill, which helped revive momentum in its obesity business earlier this year.

SA contributor Edmund Ingham noted in a recent analysis that despite stagnant revenue growth, “management's reset and pipeline strategy prompt a Buy upgrade” and the drugmaker’s “oral GLP-1 edge and strategic reset offer a credible path to long-term recovery from its current nadir.”
shares are down just over 20% YTD, hitting a low in October - a level last seen in 2021.

title: Novo Nordisk set to report Q3 results as investors watch GLP-1 sales and outlook
